info.name: BiblePlus Admin — QA & UAT Regression
info.description:
Covers every backend fix from PR #1 (QA sheet) and PR #2 (UAT sheet).

## How to run
1. Import this collection **and** the environment file next to it.
2. Set `baseUrl`, `adminEmail`, `adminPassword` in the environment.
3. Run **00 · Setup → Admin login** first — it captures the token every other request uses.
4. Then run the whole collection in order (Collection Runner). Folders 01-10 create and clean up their own data.

## Reading the results
Requests named **REGRESSION** assert a specific bug stays fixed. If one of those fails, the bug is back.

## Requires a file attachment
Three requests in *03 · Books* upload an image. Postman cannot store binaries in a shared collection, so attach any small image to the file field before running them, or skip them.
